title: Aspire Rover Plus Vape Kit
description: The Aspire Rover Plus Vape Kit combines a modern approach to a classic vape kit form factor, with advanced functionality and innovative features, making it an excellent choice for both beginner and experienced adult vapers. The kit is powered by a robust 2600mAh built-in battery, ensuring long-lasting performance, and can be quickly recharged via USB Type-C. The Rover Plus offers a 5-40W variable output, customizable through various modes such as Variable Wattage, Variable Voltage, Bypass, Temperature Control, and Custom Curve (CPS). The 0.96” TFT colour screen provides a clear display of all essential settings and real-time data, including output power, coil resistance, and battery life. Paired with the 2ml AF Tank, the Rover Plus ensures an exceptional vaping experience. The tank features a top-fill mechanism for easy refilling and 360° adjustable airflow to minimize leaks and enhance flavour. It is compatible with Aspire’s AF coil series , available in 0.4ohm, 0.6ohm, and 1ohm resistances, catering to both MTL and DTL vaping styles. Coil Details We recommend using the following E-Liquid with these coils. Aspier AF Mesh Coil 0.4ohm - Use High VG (sub-ohm) E-liquid Aspier AF Mesh Coil 0.6ohm - Use High VG (sub-ohm) E-Liquid Aspier AF Mesh Coil 1.0ohm - Use High PG , 50/50 or NIc Salt E-Liquid MTL (sold separately) Please note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
